grammar.summary: 本课围绕「荒岛生活」展开对比叙述，重点出现由 where/which/who 引导的定语从句、have sth. done 使役结构，以及 either...or... 选择并列结构。叙事中兼用过去完成时（had brought, had stayed）体现「先于过去的动作」，但最突出的仍是上述三种句法结构。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 who/which 或关系副词 where 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 where 修饰 paradise（地点），用 which 修饰 boat（物），用 who 修饰 two men（人），使长句紧凑、信息层层叠加。

examples.en: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines.
examples.cn: 我们有时想象荒岛是阳光终日普照的天堂。

examples.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, Waiting for a boat which never comes.
examples.cn: 要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙那样，天天盼船来，却总没见船影。

examples.en: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
examples.cn: 最近有两个人在一座珊瑚岛上呆了5天，他们真希望在那儿再多呆一些日子。

points.title: have sth. done 使役结构 (Causative have)
points.explanation: have + 宾语 + 过去分词表示「让某事被（别人）做」，宾语是动作的承受者。本课两人驾着坏船去迈阿密，目的是「让人修理」，故用 to have it repaired，过去分词 repaired 表被动。

examples.en: They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired.
examples.cn: 他们驾着一条严重损坏的小船从维尔京群岛（前往迈阿密去）修理。

points.title: either... or... 选择并列结构 (Correlative either...or)
points.explanation: either...or... 连接两个对等的选项，意为「要么……要么……」。本课用它连接 starve to death 与 live like Robinson Crusoe 两个动词短语，勾勒出荒岛生活的两种极端结局，与「天堂」形成对比。

examples.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, Waiting for a boat which never comes.
examples.cn: 要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙那样，天天盼船来，却总没见船影。

exercises.q: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise ______ the sun always shines.
They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to ______ repaired.
You ______ starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe... 句中 either...or... 连接的两个选项是：
用定语从句填空：Two men ______ recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.（写出引导词）
下列哪个词与课文中 wretched 的含义最接近？
